{
  "$schema": "https://anthropic.com/claude-code/plugin.schema.json",
  "name": "session-dashboard",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A mod that shows the session at a glance in one pane: what needs attention, ship-session and acceptance progress, the current branch's PR (CI, review, unresolved threads), and the servers and containers started in this session. It also blocks mass-kill commands such as pkill -f, killall and docker stop $(docker ps -q).",
  "author": {
    "name": "Seiya Kawamura"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/insession-space/claude-ship",
  "repository": "https://github.com/insession-space/claude-ship",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "dashboard",
    "pane",
    "github",
    "pull-request",
    "ci",
    "ui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
